parameters.query: select cs.id as step_id, cs.campaign_id, cs.step_number, cs.action_type as step_action_type, cs.utm_campaign, o.result, o.action_id, c.account, c.salesforce_campaign_id from outcomes o join cadence_steps cs on cs.action_id = o.action_id join campaigns c on c.id = cs.campaign_id where o.measured_at >= now() - interval '1 day' and c.status = 'active' and cs.adaptive_action is null;

select count(*) filter (where status in ('pending','recommended')) as remaining_steps, (select id from cadence_steps where campaign_id = $1 and status = 'pending' order by step_number asc limit 1) as next_step_id, (select action_type from cadence_steps where campaign_id = $1 and status = 'pending' order by step_number asc limit 1) as next_step_action_type, (select count(*) from cadence_steps where campaign_id = $1 and action_type in ('phone','linkedin_connect','invite','partner') and status in ('executed','measured')) as high_touch_used, (select count(*) from engagement_events where campaign = $2) as total_engagement from cadence_steps where campaign_id = $1;
